name: Quantity Discounts, Breaks & Product Bundles for Woocommerce By Bundler
author: WooBundles

sections.description:
Quantity Breaks Demo | Bundle Demo | Documentation with real examples | Ask Questions | PRO version | Community

Bundler is the ultimate WooCommerce quantity discounts and product bundling plugin. Easily create bulk discounts, dynamic pricing, and irresistible bundle offers to boost your sales and increase your Average Order Value (AOV) — without complex setup.

Whether you run a dropshipping store, digital shop, or a large e-commerce brand, Bundler helps you sell more and retain customers by presenting your offers in a clean, conversion-focused way.

With Bundler, you can create:

  • Quantity breaks
  • Quantity discounts
  • Product Bundles
  • Volume discounts
  • Dynamic pricing
  • Discount rules
  • Bulk discounts
  • Product swatches
  • Buy One Get One (BOGO) offers
  • And much more!

🎥 Watch a Quick Demo | 🚀 See Bundler in Action

🔥 Why Choose Bundler?

  • Boost Sales & AOV – Encourage customers to buy more with quantity breaks, bundles, and BOGO deals.
  • Dynamic Pricing Made Easy – Prices update instantly in the cart and checkout.
  • Beautiful Swatches – Highlight offers with attractive, conversion-focused visuals.
  • Seamless Experience – Offers appear on product pages, carts, checkout, and email notifications.
  • No-Code Setup – Create and launch offers in minutes.

✅ Core Features (Free Version)

  • Unlimited Quantity Discounts and Bundles for simple products

Create quantity breaks, bulk discounts, volume pricing, BOGO (Buy One Get One), Buy X Get Y, and more.

  • Dynamic Pricing

Automatic price adjustments based on discount rules.

Attractive Swatches

Use beautiful color swatches to showcase offers visually to drive conversions.

  • Custom Marketing Messages

Add persuasive texts like “Buy 2, Get Free Shipping” to make your offer more powerful.

  • Live Preview

See changes as you build offers, before publishing.

  • Preselect Offers

Subtly push your clients to take a specific offer by preselecting it. Add specific marketing messages to make it even more powerful (Buy 1 get 1 free, Buy 2 get free shipping, etc..).

  • Customize the design

Bundler provides a variety of design options to help you choose different structures for your offers, edit the colors and the texts, in a way that fits your brand identity.

  • Easy Integration

Use shortcodes to embed offers anywhere (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, etc.).

  • Sales Analytics Dashboard

Track revenue, AOV, and performance of each offer.

  • One-Click Redirects

Redirect to cart or checkout after adding a bundle.

🏆 Premium Features (Pro Version)

ALL THE FEATURES IN THE FREE VERSION PLUS:

  • Variable Products Support

Create bundles and discounts for variable products. Combine product variations to create bundle offers that get sales!

  • Custom Variations

You can use WooCommerce native variations to create bundles, but you can also get creative and make your own bundle variations. The goal here is to make it a NO BRAINER for your clients to buy your offers.

See demo here 👉 Custom variants demo

  • Apply your offers on all products, specific products or specific collections/categories

You can choose to apply your offers on all products, specific products or specific collections/categories. This gives you more flexibility and saves you a lot of time.

  • Add images for your product bundles

Illustrate the content of your offers by creating awesome product swatches and adding images to them.

  • Multi-Currency Support

Compatible with CURCY (By Villatheme), Price Based on Country, FOX Currency Switcher, YayCurrency and WooPayments multi-currency.

  • 100% Design Customization

You can customise everything! the colors, the fonts, the template and even the add to cart button. You can also preview the customisations before publishing them to the storefront.

  • Priority Support

Get help fast whenever you need it to make the most out of your plugin.

Upgrade to Bundler Pro

🛠 Developer Friendly

  • Clean, optimized code following WordPress best practices.
  • Hooks and filters for easy customization and integration.
  • Lightweight and fully compatible with caching and performance plugins.

🌐 Compatibility

Bundler works seamlessly with:
* Most WooCommerce themes
* Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, and other builders
* FunnelKit (Cart, Funnel Builder, Checkout)
* WooCommerce Subscriptions
* WPML & Loco Translate
* CURCY by Villatheme
* Price Based on Country
* FOX Currency Switcher
* YayCurrency – WooCommerce Multi-Currency Switcher
* WooPayments
* Stripe For WooCommerce
* PayPal Payments

📈 Perfect For

  • WooCommerce stores (physical or digital products)
  • Dropshipping businesses
  • Subscription products
  • Stores looking to increase AOV and customer retention

📣 Join the Bundler Community

  • Join our Facebook Group – Share tips, request features, and get marketing insights.
  • Request Support – Get help from our friendly team.

🔒 Privacy Policy

Bundler uses the Appsero SDK for optional telemetry data (with user consent) to improve performance and troubleshooting. No data is collected without explicit approval.

Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bundler directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Bundler → Settings to configure your quantity discounts, bundles, and offers.
sections.faq:
Why should I use Bundler?

  • If you are an eCommerce business owner, you should definitely use Bundler to: Increase average order on your store, boost conversion rate, outbid your competitors and increase your profit.

Do I need to have coding skills to use Bundler?

  • Absolutely not. You can create and manage bundles and offers without any coding knowledge. Bundler is the most beginner friendly bundle plugin on the market.

Is Bundler compatible with any WooCommerce Theme?

  • Yes, Bundler is compatible with any WooCommerce Theme including OceanWP / Astra / Flatsome / X-Theme / Divi… But sometimes it may require small css tweak.

Does it work on MultiSite?

  • Yes, it is.

Does it work for simple and variable products?

  • Absolutely! While Bundler Lite (the free version of Bundler) works for simple products only, you can upgrade to the pro version to use it on variable products.

Does Bundler work for digital products?

  • Yes! Bundler is a Woocommerce based bundle solution that can be used for both physical and digital products.

What’s included in the pro licence?

  • In addition to all the features included in the free version (Bundler Lite), the pro version allows you to create offers and bundles for variable products, create your own custom variations, show more marketing messages and preselect offers. Bundler Pro also integrates with most page builders and multi-currency plugins. Check out the full list of Pro features here

Is it possible to provide BOGO deals?

  • Absolutely! Bundler helps building BOGO deals in a 100% intuitive way.

How to setup Quantity Breaks?

  • Navigate to your product admin page and follow our step-by-step video tutorial.

I’d like access to all features. How can I get them?

  • You can get access to more features and support by upgrading to our Pro version. Purchasing a Pro license gets you access to the full version of Bundler, automatic updates and priority support.
